scope: R10 single-slot HTTP/SSE service calibration; no held-out execution

holdout_rate_transfer.oasst: same synthetic tick scale as the selected calibration anchor
holdout_rate_transfer.bailian: selected coding service scale divided by the frozen coding prefill scale, then multiplied by each destination source's frozen prefill scale

extension_rule.shoulder_if_both_ends_exist: arithmetic midpoint of the widest untested interval between the selected low and overload clocks; prefer longer clock on a tie
extension_rule.scope: choose only from baseline queue and drain windows; retain the original SLO, output caps, model, capacity, and three original rates

experimental_slo.one_token_tpot: not applicable; visible text and terminal success required

anchor_rules.selection: apply per family and output profile on baseline only; choose the first observed eligible low, closest shoulder to 0.8 busy with drain as tie break, and smallest observed overload by drain fraction; report missing anchors or extend calibration before opening service holdout
